provenance.ballPolicy: The game basketball is separately rendered. Leo reaches with open empty hands; the separate ball meets his hands at frame3/tick5 and follows his controlled rebound gather. No ball is painted into any pose.

cleanup.method: shared five-pose component isolation and nearest antialiased-pixel reassignment; 3x2 row-major atlas pack; final cell transparent

review.reviewNotes: Five distinct full-body poses show set, jump, high reach, empty-hand catch at frame3/tick5, and recovery. Leo remains pale, adult and human with long wavy black hair, refined mustache and black/crimson kit. No ball is visible.

provenance.packaging: package-action5.py; 80x96 cells; baseline94; lossless WebP; 5 original rebound poses
